description: Create a NEW Vibie site by uploading a local folder. Use this when the user wants to publish a brand new site, or when no .vibie/site.json marker exists in the folder. Vibie hosts static HTML/CSS/JS at a permanent URL like my-site-a3f9.vibie.page. Auto-creates a .vibie/site.json marker in the folder for future updates.

category.description: Category id (portfolio / wedding / landing / event / game / photo / linkbio / misc). Defaults to misc.

folder.description: Absolute or relative path to the folder containing index.html (or a single HTML file). Required.

is_public.description: Whether the site appears in the public gallery. Defaults to true.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to folder name.

name: vibie_create_site
